text: Most climate scientists think global warming is happening.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: Yale/GMU Climate Change in the American Mind
room.questionWording: Which comes closest to your own view? Most scientists think global warming is happening / there is a lot of disagreement among scientists / most scientists think global warming is not happening / don’t know enough to say
room.note: VERIFY before shipping: fill fieldDates and n from the Spring 2026 report; figures are from the brief and were not re-read from the report in this environment.
